notes: Moves Whole Skin / Global Style into its own dedicated tall Skin-Wide Controls rectangle, separate from individual Text, Tags, and Stats controls. Global font and all-text solid/gradient overrides now export through an explicit registry of real AO3 selectors rather than depending on the mock preview. Coverage includes the AO3 logo/header, primary and secondary navigation, logged-in user/profile menus, dropdowns, search, Dashboard/Subscriptions/Bookmarks/History-style header links, work titles/bylines, fandoms/tags/Series/metadata/stats, chapter and fic text, comments, kudos, actions/navigation, forms, and footer. Existing per-element settings remain preserved underneath the reversible global overrides.
